item.title: We gave 5 LLMs $100K to trade stocks for 8 months
Thoughts on Go vs. Rust vs. Zig
item.description:
📝 I’ve tried to synthesize my experience with each language into a sweeping verdict on what that language values and how well it executes on those values. The end result is a language that forces you to write a lot of boilerplate code to implement logic that could be more succinctly expressed in another language. I agree with Jamie Brandon, who writes that it’s not lifetimes that make Rust difficult, it’s the number of concepts stuffed into the language.
🔗 Read more: https://sinclairtarget.com/blog/2025/08/thoughts-on-go-vs.-rust-vs.-zig/
